meta.name: baoyu-compress-image
meta.description: Compresses images to WebP (default) or PNG with automatic tool selection. Use when user asks to "compress image", "optimize image", "convert to webp", or reduce image file size.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩图片为 WebP 或 PNG 格式，减小文件体积
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要压缩图片或转换格式来节省空间
copy.tagline_en: Compress images to WebP or PNG to reduce file size
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compress images or convert formats to save space

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能压缩图片:默认转成 WebP,也可输出 PNG 或 JPEG,自动挑选可用工具(sips、cwebp、ImageMagick、Sharp)。可设质量、保留原图、递归处理目录,并报告压缩前后的大小。
howto.when: 当你提到「压缩图片」「优化图片」等关键词,或想转成 webp、减小图片文件体积时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这张图压缩成 webp
say.note: 默认质量 80,输出同路径新扩展名

say.text: 把 ./images 目录里的图按质量 75 全部压缩,保留原图
say.note: 递归处理子目录,不删原文件

say.text: 压缩这张图,并用 JSON 给我结果

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can compress images — default output is WebP, with PNG or JPEG optional. It auto-selects a tool (sips, cwebp, ImageMagick, Sharp) and reports before/after file sizes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "compress image", "optimize image", or "convert to webp", or ask to reduce an image's file size.

say_en.note: Default quality 80, new extension at same path

say_en.text: Compress the ./images folder at quality 75, keep originals
Compress it and give me the result as JSON
